title: Baseball Game
summary: Maintain a record of baseball game scores with specific operations.
statement: Maintain a record of baseball game scores with specific operations. Given a list of operations, apply each to the record. Operations include recording a score, summing the last two scores, doubling the last score, or invalidating the last score. Return the total score after applying all operations.
constraints: 1 <= len(operations) <= 1,000; every operation is valid given prior scores.
An integer records a score, C removes the previous score, D doubles it, and + sums the previous two.
hints: Every operation depends only on the current valid score record.
Use a stack so cancellation and recent-score references are direct.
Push integers/D/+ results, pop on C, then sum the stack.
The stack exactly mirrors the mutable record after each valid operation.
editorial: The stack exactly mirrors the mutable record after each valid operation.

tests.explanation: The record evolves to [5,10,15], totaling thirty.
Applying all stack operations produces twenty-seven.
